subject: General Knowledge
description: Film pioneers, Dadasaheb Phalke, first films, industry hubs

questions.explanation: Dadasaheb Phalke — made India's first feature film 'Raja Harishchandra' (silent, 1913). Also called the 'Father of Indian Cinema'. The Dadasaheb Phalke Award (instituted 1969) is India's highest honour in cinema. Dhundiraj Govind Phalke.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The FIRST Indian TALKIE (sound) film was:
questions.explanation: Alam Ara — released 14 March 1931, directed by Ardeshir Irani. India's FIRST sound-film. Raja Harishchandra was SILENT. Other cinema firsts: Kisan Kanya (1937) — first Indian colour film; Aan (1952) — first in 16 mm colour; Mughal-e-Azam (1960) — first blockbuster Cinemascope.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Satyajit Ray won an HONORARY Academy Award (Oscar) for lifetime achievement in:
questions.explanation: Satyajit Ray — honorary Oscar in March 1992, shortly before his death (23 April 1992). First Indian to receive it. Also Bharat Ratna posthumously (1992). Famous 'Apu Trilogy' (Pather Panchali 1955, Aparajito 1956, Apur Sansar 1959) + Charulata, Shatranj ke Khilari.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: India's FIRST film to win an Oscar (as an Indian submission) was:

options.option_text: Gandhi (1982) — but co-produced by UK; not strictly an Indian film winning
'Naatu Naatu' song from RRR (Best Original Song, 2023) + The Elephant Whisperers (Best Documentary Short, 2023)

questions.explanation: At the 95th Oscars (March 2023), 'Naatu Naatu' from the Telugu film RRR (composer M. M. Keeravani, lyricist Chandrabose) won Best Original Song — first Indian song. 'The Elephant Whisperers' (Kartiki Gonsalves) won Best Documentary Short — first all-Indian production to win. Mother India (1957), Lagaan (2001) were nominated (Best Foreign Language) but lost.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: Match the FILM INDUSTRY with its LOCATION. A. Bollywood.  B. Tollywood (Telugu).  C. Kollywood.  D. Mollywood. List-II: 1. Mumbai.  2. Hyderabad.  3. Chennai (Kodambakkam).  4. Kerala.
questions.explanation: Bollywood — Hindi film industry, Mumbai. Tollywood originally named for Tollygunge (Bengal); now commonly used for the Telugu industry based in Hyderabad. Kollywood — Tamil (Kodambakkam, Chennai). Mollywood — Malayalam (Kerala). Sandalwood — Kannada (Bengaluru).
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The NATIONAL FILM AWARD for Best Actor is officially named:
questions.explanation: National Film Awards — Swarna Kamal (Golden Lotus) for top films (Best Feature, Direction etc.), Rajat Kamal (Silver Lotus) for Best Actor / Actress / many others. Instituted 1954, presented by the President of India. Dadasaheb Phalke Award is a lifetime-achievement honour given separately by the same authority.
questions.subject: General Knowledge

questions.stem: The INTERNATIONAL FILM FESTIVAL OF INDIA (IFFI) is held annually in:
questions.explanation: IFFI — founded 1952. Permanent venue since 2004: Goa (Panaji). Organised by the Ministry of I&B. Usually held in November. The top award is the Peacock (Golden / Silver).
